headline: Strike in Zagreb getting closer. Tomašević: What they are demanding is unrealistic
summary: A strike by ZET and Holding in Zagreb threatens to begin on Monday, 28 September, after negotiations failed. Mayor Tomašević considers the union's demands unrealistic.
why: ZET is the Zagreb public transport operator, and labour disputes at municipal companies can disrupt city services and public budgets.
